extracted.intended_audience: agency IT managers, Office of Computer Services staff, executive officers and comptrollers responsible for ADP management and improvement
extracted.subtask_description: Documenting, planning, and reporting automatic data processing (ADP) improvements and cost-reduction measures within a federal agency; covers hardware/software changes, operational standards, measurement, governance bodies, and accounting for savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting format: Identification of Program or Function and Description of Improvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Reports should identify the program or function and provide a description of the improvement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document consistently organizes entries under columns 'Identification of Program or Function' and 'Description of Improvement' to capture what was changed or planned for each ADP area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Phase out of RCA Computer Systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Phase out RCA Spectra 70/35 and Spectra 70/45 computer systems and migrate their work to existing IBM systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Planned for FY-73: release RCA systems during the first quarter of FY-73 and handle work on extant IBM systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mass Storage (online storage evaluation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate and test new technology to permit storing very large amounts of data on-line to reduce the magnetic tape library and manual tape operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Less-than-full-scale test could be conducted towards the end of FY-73; if successful, production system could be operational during FY-74.

rubrics_metrics.name: Computer Graphics modernization
rubrics_metrics.description: Study new computer graphics systems (e.g., Anagraph) that could replace existing graphics equipment such as the IBM 2250 and BR 90 to achieve lower cost and wider usability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Objective is to obtain a lower cost graphics system usable by a wider group of users; study ORD research for applicability and potential replacements/changes to OCS equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Computer measurement (utilization metrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop new and better computer measurement techniques to examine more positively the effectiveness of utilization of computer resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: During FY-73 further refinement and standardization of measurement processes is projected to improve examination of resource utilization effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: ADP standards and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop agency-wide ADP standards, including Standard Operating Procedure for Computer Centers and qualifications/career development/training requirements for computer operators and systems programmers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work with various offices and staffs to produce standards that can be widely applied to all computer components in the agency; activities targeted to reach fruition in specified areas during FY-73.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development of Generalized Information Management System (GIMS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop an on-line generalized information management system to replace many existing on-line systems and avoid the need for additional tailor-made systems for several years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Objective is a single system of sufficient scope to meet many users' requirements, producing savings in programming effort, user indoctrination, and application effort; development was joint between PCS personnel and a vendor; acceptance testing anticipated early in FY-73 with first application to SIPS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidation of computer operations (Signal Analysis and Processing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consolidate selected computer-related activities concerned with signal analysis and processing into a Headquarters Signal Analysis and Processing Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expected benefits include closer working relationships among components and users, reduction of contractor-supplied analysis/support, savings in office and equipment space; implementation may require phased moves and further study of implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCS Configuration Board governance
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain a configuration board to review computer system performance and plans for hardware/software changes to improve reliability and productivity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Board (established September 1971) met weekly to review performance and planned changes to obtain greater reliability and productivity from PCS computer resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Accounting and Pricing System (reporting of resource use and cost)
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce management reports showing computer resources and prices for jobs processed in the PCS Computer Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First report: annual report by user office; scheduled release early August 1972; monthly and quarterly reports planned thereafter to inform management of resource usage and pricing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Installation of non-IBM computer components
rubrics_metrics.description: Procure and install non-IBM computer components competitive in capability, performance, and cost to diversify equipment base.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of replacements procured include AMP EX memory units, CALCOMP disk units, MEMOREX communications controllers, DATA 100 and REMCON remote job entry terminals, DELTA DATA CRT terminals, DATEL typewriter terminal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Installation of Attached Support Processor System (ASP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement ASP to allow sharing of peripheral units by interconnected computers, changing hardware configuration, system software, and resource scheduling concepts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initial implementation caused instability and user frustration due to reconfigurations, software problems, and new procedures; by September system smoothed out and an estimated 25% increase in productivity was realized; later tied into IBM 360/195 to make a triplex ASP system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fixed term contracts for components
rubrics_metrics.description: Place computer components on fixed-term contracts to gain reduced rental costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: some 42 IBM components were placed on fixed term contracts for FY-72 to take advantage of reduced rentals; used as a cost reduction measure.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCS Resource Management Board (project approval/review)
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish a Resource Management Board to approve initiation of new projects and review ongoing projects above a cost threshold.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Board met monthly to approve new projects and to review ongoing projects where cost exceeds a specified amount (cost threshold indicated as a policy trigger).

rubrics_metrics.name: OCS-IBM joint management meetings
rubrics_metrics.description: Hold regular meetings with IBM sales and customer engineering management to improve communications, service, and IBM support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program of weekly meetings initiated with the objective of improving communications and IBM support in general.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve computer environment and electrical facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Renovate computer rooms to improve cooling, humidification, and electrical power stability to reduce downtime and failures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Renovations made to improve environmental controls; installation of a motor generator system for 60 and 400 cycle computer power greatly reduced failures caused by transients or momentary power interruptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical review of agency-wide ADP proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: Designate Office of Computer Services to be responsible for technical review and recommendation for all ADP hardware or software proposals submitted for approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directive in February 1972 required OCS to perform technical review; by end of fiscal year eighteen such proposals had been reviewed—this is a governance/control criterion to centralize technical vetting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set cost-reduction goals and track use of savings
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish overall cost-reduction dollar savings goals for the current year and track achieved savings and their disposition (finance other unit requirements, reprogram for other requirements, place in reserve or apply to reducing the President's budget).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section VII requires summary descriptions of past year cost reduction achievements and explicit identification of how savings are used (a. finance other approved requirements; b. reprogrammed; c. placed in reserve or applied to reducing President's budget).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific cost-reduction measures (examples)
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement concrete cost-reduction actions such as use of fixed-term contracts for IBM components and substitution of Calcomp disk storage devices for IBM disk storage devices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documented savings in ADP rentals during FY-72 attributed to: a. use of fixed-term contracts for IBM components (drums, disk storage drives, control units); b. use of Calcomp disk storage devices in place of IBM devices; totals and dollar savings should be reported.
